liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Help On The Way** (2 reviews): Opening Help On The Way into Slipknot! into Franklin's Tower was powerful; The two explosive opening notes felt like the floor might crack open [6][7]
- **Franklin's Tower** (1 review): A noticeable mistake near the end of Franklin's, though others insist it wasn't one [7]
- **The Same Thing** (1 review): Named among the reviewer's favorites of the show [10]
- **Althea** (1 review): Althea is singled out as great, along with Throwing Stones [11]
- **Smokestack Lightning** (1 review): Named among the reviewer's favorites, along with Cassidy [10]
- **Days Between** (1 review): Standout of the show; Bobby sounds distorted and Vince plays a harpsichord tone like China Doll [12]
- **Throwing Stones** (1 review): Described as sublime and worth hearing [15]
- **Not Fade Away** (1 review): Not Fade Away and U.S. Blues are strong, with energy building toward the end [15]

## Setlist highlights

- **Childhood's End**: rare: 13 archived performances [18]

## The recordings

- **gd94-10-18.schoeps.ladner.10086.sbeok.shnf** (recommended): audience recording; 21 songs; 166 min; rated 2.83/5 by 6 [1]. Said about its sound: Audience recording sounds pretty nice, though a soundboard already exists on CD; Audience recording is only decent [6][10]
- **gd1994-10-18.akg460.flaschner.sobel.85384.flac16**: source not stated; 19 songs; 166 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [2]
- **gd1994-10-18.sbd.wiley.8708.sbefail.shnf**: soundboard; 19 songs; 158 min; rated 4.67/5 by 3 [3]. Said about its sound: Soundboard has some fuzz and buzz when turned up [11]
- **gd1994-10-18.sbd.miller.119523.flac16**: soundboard; 19 songs; 158 min; rated 3.2/5 by 10 [4]

## Around the show

- Reviewer and girlfriend took blotter just before entering and were tripping heavily by their seats [7]
- Left parents a note about going to New York on a school night, then got to school next day [8]
- Bobby seemed barely present all night; reviewer wondered whether he was ill [9]
- Second set put Truckin' after Smokestack and He's Gone in a reversed order from the usual sequence [6]
- Reviewer found this a weak Fall 94 show, not a hidden gem [9]
- Reviewer considers it a great show for the mid-90s [15]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd94-10-18.schoeps.ladner.10086.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience: Schoeps CMC521's [1]. Also: Schoeps CMC 521 microphones, recorded to DAT, then CDR; passed along via Paul and seeded to etree by neolevo [1]
- **gd1994-10-18.akg460.flaschner.sobel.85384.flac16**: taped by Dave Flaschner; transferred by Jason Sobel; source: AKG 460B/ck61 > custom pre-amp > Sony D7 (@ 48 kHz) [2]. Also: Transferred from master DATs borrowed from Dave; original 48 kHz wav files archived and available on request [2]
- **gd1994-10-18.sbd.wiley.8708.sbefail.shnf**: transferred by Tim Wiley; source: SBD>DAT>C*>CDR [3]
- **gd1994-10-18.sbd.miller.119523.flac16**: transferred by Charlie Miller; source: SBD -> Dat -> Cassette Master -> Dat (48k) [4]
